Keep at least 50,000 USDC reachable within 30 days to cover payroll.
Never put more than 20% of the portfolio in private credit.
Do not hold BTC Real Yield at all.
Leave at least 7 days of notice cover before any known liability.
Prefer higher yield where the above still holds.
